about: S-SPECs found by Skills/find-sspec beyond ARK and Wikipedia, each with its evidence: an Intel document, an S-SPEC database page, or the marking on the package read from photographs of different chips. A model searched with nothing found is kept with no specs.

models.note: Intel 6th Generation Processor Family Specification Update 332689-010EN (copy at helptechco.com/files/pdf_files/BX80662I36100_PDF_0.pdf) Identification table lists only retail S-0/R-0 Pentium/Celeron SKUs (G4520 SR2HM, G4500 SR2HJ, G4500T SR2HS, G4400 SR2HK, G4400T SR2HQ, G3900 SR2HV, G3900T SR2HT, G3920 SR2HX); this model is absent. Intel EDS addendum 334408-001 (cdrdv2-public.intel.com/334408) also lacks it. Only a CPE vulnerability-database entry (cpe.gcve.eu/cpes/528839) names the model, with no code. Photos: 48 images incl. '"G3920T" SR2H', 'G3920T 赛扬' - none shows a G3920T package (G3920, G3900T only).

Intel 6th Generation Processor Family Specification Update 332689-010EN (copy at helptechco.com/files/pdf_files/BX80662I36100_PDF_0.pdf) Identification table lists only retail S-0/R-0 Pentium/Celeron SKUs (G4520 SR2HM, G4500 SR2HJ, G4500T SR2HS, G4400 SR2HK, G4400T SR2HQ, G3900 SR2HV, G3900T SR2HT, G3920 SR2HX); this model is absent. Intel EDS addendum 334408-001 (cdrdv2-public.intel.com/334408) also lacks it. A search summary mentioned an anonymous user comment on cpu-world (G3940 = SR2HW, 3.00GHz) but cpu-world refuses WebFetch (403), so it is not a source; '"SR2HW" Intel' finds nothing; vstl.info/cpus/sr2hw is 404. Photos: one chip only - zhihu.com/p/133316161 (2 images of the same chip, pic1.zhimg.com/v2-5cfc0b7390e3d4abb660deb45636fb10_1440w.jpg sha256 5dd0495b76dd680f0c84e281ed9f500bb3d08cdd9a01ba0d6b71c07c6f7e0325 and pic3.zhimg.com/v2-d4ab8c63d0a3530116715e696d13eedc_1440w.jpg sha256 3c9a82688b116866b339649cb9d325ce54adb8daf63256ae861c943093b9cf0e) reads 'INTEL CELERON / G3940 / SR2HW 3.00GHZ / L533B429 (e4)', all characters legible. Candidate SR2HW, NOT recorded: no second chip with a different lot found in 64 images (queries 'SR2HW', 'SR2HW G3940', 'G3940 赛扬', 'G3940 CPU 1151'), and no Intel/database page confirms it.
